victim.name: Director Kessler Voss
victim.backgroundBlurb: Director Kessler Voss was a ruthless corporate climber known for burning bridges and extracting value at any cost. His sudden demise via neuro-toxin in his private estate leaves behind a wake of suspects and motives.

setting.eventDescription: An exclusive gala hosted by Voss to announce a major new cyberware contract. Only the elite and their trusted entourage were invited.
